input: Build a capsule wardrobe for the office

gold.taskTitle: Build a capsule wardrobe for the office
gold.taskDescription: Plan and assemble a cohesive, minimal set of versatile clothing items suited for a professional office environment.

questions.title: What is the dress code at your workplace?
questions.description: Understanding whether the environment is business formal, business casual, or smart casual will shape every item selected.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this wardrobe?
questions.description: Knowing the budget determines whether to shop at high street, mid-range, or investment-piece level retailers.

questions.title: How many days per week do you go into the office?
questions.description: The number of in-office days dictates how many outfits and pieces are needed to avoid repeating looks too soon.

questions.title: What climate or season are you dressing for?
questions.description: Temperature, humidity, and seasonal changes affect fabric choices, layering needs, and the types of outerwear required.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred colour palette in mind?
questions.description: A defined colour palette ensures all pieces mix and match easily and reflect the user's personal style.

questions.title: Are there any clothing items you already own to keep?
questions.description: Identifying existing wardrobe staples prevents unnecessary purchases and helps fill only the true gaps.

questions.title: Do you need outfits for client meetings or presentations?
questions.description: If high-stakes meetings are frequent, the wardrobe may need a few elevated, more formal pieces beyond everyday office wear.
